annotations.title: Resolve a parcel in the registry

description: Find a parcel's FactLot URN from state FIPS, county FIPS, and APN, if the registry holds it. A miss returns urn null with coverage: whether that county is loaded in this registry. Requires a FactLot Registry (public-record facts about commercial property, each cited to the source file and record).

apn.description: Parcel or account number as the county prints it: an appraisal district account number in Texas, a borough-block-lot (e.g. 1000020002) in New York City, an AIN in Los Angeles County, a parcel number in San Francisco, a PID in Boston, a schedule number in Denver, the CAMA link in Connecticut.

county_fips.description: 3-digit county FIPS, e.g. "201" for Harris County, Texas, or "061" for New York County (Manhattan).

state_fips.description: 2-digit state FIPS, e.g. "48" for Texas, "36" for New York.

name: registry_resolve_parcel
